sd_chopping_block.name: Chopping Block
sd_chopping_block.note: Only 'spring to fall, occasional winter day' season words for the Rushmore area; no source names months.

va_labyrinth.name: Labyrinth
va_labyrinth.note: No month-naming source; only that High Knob is high, wet and snowy, and a 'good year round if sunny' remark about the region.

wi_grandad_bluff.name: Grandad Bluff
wi_grandad_bluff.note: No source names climbing months; MP chart unreadable; only 'spring, summer, fall' visitor words.

ak_archangel_valley_sport_and_traditiona.name: Archangel Valley Sport and Traditional Climbing
ak_archangel_valley_sport_and_traditiona.note: Statewide May-Sept guidance and 'into September' only; nothing naming Archangel Valley months.

az_mine_area_the.name: Mine Area, The
az_mine_area_the.note: Sources say winter/cooler months with monsoon Jul-Aug to avoid, but none names months.

bc_hunter_creek_bouldering.name: Hunter Creek Bouldering
bc_hunter_creek_bouldering.note: Season words only: 'spring through fall' (Oddworld/Pale Face listings), 'nearly all year'; no months.

ca_eagle_creek_canyon.name: Eagle Creek Canyon
ca_eagle_creek_canyon.note: All Lake Tahoe: Tahoe climbing season 'usually begins in May and runs through mid-November'; MP says many rocks climbable year round when dry (consistent, snow sets the limit). Tahoe-wide months applied to this canyon; its ice season is a different thing.

nh_whitehorse_ledge.name: Whitehorse Ledge
nh_whitehorse_ledge.note: SummitPost: rock season April-October, Sept-Oct best; VT Sports: Standard Route often climbable by early April; North Conway guiding runs late April to late Nov (town-wide).

oh_hocking_hills_state_forest.name: Hocking Hills State Forest
oh_hocking_hills_state_forest.note: Only 'spring and fall' general visitor words; nothing month-naming for climbing.

or_portland_the_gorge.name: Portland & The Gorge
or_portland_the_gorge.note: Spring and fall best (Broughton Bluff, Smith Rock); Beacon Rock south face has a spring raptor closure; no months named.

sd_shadowlands.name: Shadowlands
sd_shadowlands.note: MP says Shadowlands is a summer wall (shady); canyon 'nearly year-round' / late spring to early fall; no months.

vt_burnt_mountain.name: Burnt Mountain
vt_burnt_mountain.note: No climbing source found for this crag; only a regional note that northern Vermont is too cold by November.

wa_empire_boulders.name: Empire Boulders
wa_empire_boulders.note: No season text found; only guidebook listings.

al_middle_bishop.name: Middle Bishop
al_middle_bishop.note: Nothing Bishop-specific; regional 'fall to spring' for sandstone, year-round possible.

az_dws_east_clear_creek.name: DWS East Clear Creek
az_dws_east_clear_creek.note: Season words only (spring-summer-fall, popular in summer); no months.

bc_ladybird_creek.name: Ladybird Creek
bc_ladybird_creek.note: MP text: season 'usually in April when the snow disappears until late October', fall best (Apr-Oct); no second source confirmed, so left unset.

ca_angeles_national_forest.name: Angeles National Forest
ca_angeles_national_forest.note: Only Williamson Rock (closed) 'warmer months / spring-summer-fall'; forest too varied, no months.

co_glacier_gorge.name: Glacier Gorge
co_glacier_gorge.note: RMNP-wide alpine rock windows differ (mid-Jun to late Aug vs mid-Jul to mid-Sep, Longs Peak); nothing Glacier Gorge-specific.

me_mdi_bouldering.name: MDI Bouldering
me_mdi_bouldering.note: MP Acadia page: come in the warm season, May-late September; Equinox guides: July-Sept best, late spring through early fall. Park-wide advice applied to MDI bouldering.

mi_marquette_and_central_up_roped.name: Marquette (and Central UP) Roped
mi_marquette_and_central_up_roped.note: TravelMarquette: spring, summer, fall (summer peak); ice in winter. Season words only, no months.
